items.title: Pay late-filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag)
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Betrag innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 27.01.2025. Under §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a posted tax letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: Fri 31.01.2025 (not a weekend/holiday in NW, so no shift). Per §108 Abs. 1 AO / §187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period starts the day after delivery. Per §188 Abs. 3 BGB / §108 Abs. 1 AO it ends one month later on the day matching the delivery date's number: Fri 28.02.2025. That day is a business day, so no further shift under §108 Abs. 3 AO.

items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the surcharge assessment
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
items.computation: Same delivery and counting logic as the payment deadline: deemed delivery on Fri 31.01.2025 (4th day after the 27.01.2025 posting, per §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO), period starts the next day (§187 Abs. 1 BGB), one month later under §355 Abs. 1 AO / §188 Abs. 3 BGB gives Fri 28.02.2025, which is a business day so it stands (§108 Abs. 3 AO). The Einspruch must reach the Finanzamt in writing or electronically by this date.

warnings: The letter's own text states the delivery date is presumed unless the letter actually arrived later ('es sei denn, er ist später zugegangen') — if the addressee received it after 31.01.2025, both deadlines shift accordingly and should be re-checked against the actual envelope postmark/arrival date.
